skip.ffprobe_fields: FFmpeg 8.0.1's AC-3 parser takes the sample rate from the header (24000 Hz, ac3_parser.c, eac3_parse_header) and the packets from the frame sizes, but leaves the channels of an E-AC-3 stream to the E-AC-3 decoder (aac_ac3_parser.c:132), which refuses a reduced sample rate (eac3dec.c:316-322, AVERROR_PATCHWELCOME): ffprobe gives 0 channels and no channel layout.
skip.ffprobe_bitrate: ffprobe gives no bitrate (N/A): the bit rate comes from the decoder that refuses the stream (aac_ac3_parser.c:163-167, eac3dec.c:316-322).
skip.decode: FFmpeg 8.0.1's E-AC-3 decoder refuses a reduced sample rate (eac3dec.c:316-322, AVERROR_PATCHWELCOME).
